title: Surveillance is not safety: A statement on the UK's latest threat to privacy [pdf]
summary: Signal organization releases an official statement opposing the UK's latest surveillance legislation, arguing that government-mandated access to encrypted communications undermines user safety and privacy rights.
problem_solved: Addresses the conflict between government surveillance demands and the protection of private digital communications.
why_valuable: Highlights critical trade-offs between security mandates and privacy erosion, serving as a public advocacy piece from a major encrypted messaging platform.
